title: Portal
shortDescription: A compact first-person puzzle game that teaches spatial reasoning through portals, timing, and a sharply controlled sequence of experiments.
highlights: New rules are introduced through elegant, readable test chambers
A short campaign makes every mechanic feel purposeful and memorable

signals.label: GameAtlas editorial selection
signals.rationale: A canonical PC puzzle anchor whose controlled onboarding demonstrates how a mechanic can carry an entire game when every room teaches something new.
